title: Use `async_sequence` in `ReadableStream.from`
body: Replace our manual async iterator logic with the new Web IDL `async_sequence` type and its associated operations (added in https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/pull/1397). This comes with one behavioral change: `ReadableStream.from("abc")` used to iterate over the Unicode code points of the string (per [`String.prototype[Symbol.iterator]`](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Global_Objects/String/Symbol.iterator)), but this will now throw a `TypeError` instead. This is covered by the new WPTs. Developers who want to create a `ReadableStream` from a string should update their code to either: * `ReadableStream.from(["abc"])` for a stream with a single chunk `"abc"` * `ReadableStream.from([..."abc"])` for a stream with three chunks `"a"`, `"b"`, `"c"` Supersedes https://github.com/whatwg/streams/pull/1310. (Thanks to @lucacasonato for getting this started!) - [x] At least two implementers are interested (and none opposed): * WebKit: https://github.com/whatwg/streams/pull/1372#pullrequestreview-4211624438 * Gecko: https://github.com/whatwg/streams/pull/1372#pullrequestreview-4595456536 * Chromium: https://github.com/whatwg/streams/pull/1372#issuecomment-4841373878 - [x] [Tests](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt) are written and can be reviewed and commented upon at: * https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/pull/59594 - [x] [Implementation bugs](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) are filed: * Chromium: https://issues.chromium.org/issues/531056906 * Gecko: https://bugzilla.mozilla.org/show_bug.cgi?id=2052661 * WebKit: https://bugs.webkit.org/show_bug.cgi?id=318598 * Deno: https://github.com/denoland/deno/issues/35777 * Node.js: https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/64288 - [ ] [MDN issue](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md#handling-pull-requests) is filed: … - [x] The top of this comment includes a [clear commit message](https://github.com/whatwg/meta/blob/main/COMMITTING.md) to use.
